description: Lease one remote browser with standard CDP access for 10, 30, or 60 minutes. Price: $0.05 for 600, $0.10 for 1800, $0.20 for 3600 (duration_seconds). Requires AUSCA_PRIVATE_KEY and AUSCA_MAX_PAYMENT_USD in this server's environment.

inputSchema.description: Create one remote browser lease for a supported duration.

ausca_campaign.description: Optional self-reported campaign attribution; requires ausca_source.

ausca_idempotency_key.description: Required caller-owned purchase identity. Save before payment and reuse with unchanged input to recover an uncertain response. A different key authorizes another purchase.

ausca_source.description: Optional self-reported source attribution. Reporting only; never affects payment or execution.
